sections.heading: tySlicerHelper
sections.content: ThetySlicerhelper can be used to manually slice particle bindings. By treating it like a virtual knife, you can animate it slicing across particle bindings within your scene and the corresponding bindings will break.

sections.heading: Parameters
sections.content:
Length: the length of the slicer. The “blade” of the slicer must cross over a binding in order to break it, so the length of the slicer will affect whether such an intersection takes place.Show logo: controls whether thetySlicerlogo is displayed in the viewport.
